name: Look Over There
briefing:
## Situation
Dusk, clear. Post Alpha is on open farmland. Hostile drones have been using a loud, high decoy to draw attention while a second drone comes in low from another direction. Birds, civilian hobby drones and our own patrol drone are also up.
## Mission
Detect, identify and defeat every hostile before it reaches Post Alpha. Leave birds, civilians and friendlies alone.

## Intel
Expect an RF-loud drone high to the north-east first. Do not let it hold your attention: the real threat may be low, fast and silent to the RF detector, and on the opposite side.
